heading: Energy Efficiency and Conservation Block Grant Program

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish a program, to be known as the “Energy Efficiency and Conservation Block Grant Program”, under which the Secretary shall provide grants to eligible entities in accordance with this part.

tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: The purpose of the program shall be to assist eligible entities in implementing strategies—

children.text: to reduce fossil fuel emissions created as a result of activities within the jurisdictions of eligible entities in a manner that—
to the maximum extent practicable, maximizes benefits for local and regional communities;
to reduce the total energy use of the eligible entities; and

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.
